coverage.title: It is ironic that the thing that is now most annoying about long-running agentic tasks with Large Language Models isn't coding or errors or hallucinations, but the fact that their language gets worse due to drift & cross-agent talk as a task goes on Its in your the name! Just write better already!

Hãy viết hay hơn ngay đi chứ!
